nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset address stored by CollateralLocker; used as the token target for transfers in pull().
Immutable address of the Loan contract allowed to call pull(); the trusted caller enforced by the isLoan modifier.
Sets the immutable collateralAsset and loan state variables from constructor arguments.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == loan, guarding pull().
External, isLoan-guarded function that transfers amt of collateralAsset to dst via SafeERC20.safeTransfer, performing an external token call.
Caller-supplied address used for the isLoan access-control check in the modifier applied to pull().
External call collateralAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) that invokes arbitrary token code, potentially allowing reentrancy via a malicious token callback.
Constructor parameter providing the collateral asset token address assigned to collateralAsset.
Constructor parameter providing the trusted Loan contract address assigned to loan.
Destination address receiving the collateral asset in pull(), forwarded to safeTransfer.
Amount of collateral asset transferred in pull(), forwarded to safeTransfer.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is written into the collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan is written into the loan state variable.
msg.sender flows into the isLoan modifier comparison against loan to authorize the caller.
The loan state variable is read in the isLoan modifier as the expected trusted caller.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull(), restricting it to the Loan contract.
msg.sender reaches pull() through the modifier access-control check that may revert the call.
Parameter dst is an argument of pull() used as the transfer destination.
Parameter amt is an argument of pull() used as the transfer amount.
The collateralAsset state variable is the token contract on which safeTransfer is invoked.
Parameter dst is passed as the recipient of the external safeTransfer call.
Parameter amt is passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
pull() performs an external token transfer, transferring control to the token contract before returning.
The external token call may invoke malicious token code that re-enters pull() (or other guarded functions) before state is finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _collateralAsset only exists to initialize the immutable collateralAsset state variable inside the constructor, so it should be merged into the constructor node.
Parameter _loan only exists to initialize the immutable loan state variable inside the constructor, so it should be merged into the constructor node.
Parameter dst is a transient argument that directly feeds the safeTransfer unsafe operation and the pull() call, so it should be merged into the associated unsafe operation.
